authority: D-107 one controlled student-state aggregation round
source_selection: Evenly spaced deterministic indices of all 207 original training sources, before observing any rollout result; never development sources
future_seed: 12300000 + original_all_source_index * 100, one future per training source
execution: Frozen event student executes every action from the same complete_gold initial fixture. Public growth teacher supplies labels only. No teacher interventions or teacher-state observations replace executed student states.
admission: Every source must finish with strict native/injection quality; legal recruitment deaths retained. Forced actions, outside-gate states, unsupported destructive targets and health-risk pending sequences have explicit no-label reasons.

comparison.start: Same sealed event-student checkpoint, fresh Adam for both arms
comparison.replay_control: Original demonstration data only; same mixed phase/event sampler
comparison.aggregate: Half original and half student-query labels, each using the same phase/event mixture; original development rows copied exactly

assessment: Both fixed endpoints on all 49 existing development sources, 2 futures, normal and complete_gold variants; 196 suffixes per arm. Same source-clustered comparisons against each other, parent, teacher, and the unrefined event student. No best-checkpoint selection.
stop: One round only in this window. No PPO continuation if complete-suffix ability remains worse. Final formal reserved seeds untouched.
limitations: Heuristic expert may fail outside its own distribution
Missing history is not repaired by aggregation
Artificial golden endowment does not teach natural acquisition
BC state is not a PPO Trainer
